exercises.name: Wrist Bend
exercises.hint: Press your wrist down and hold, then press up and hold. That is one rep.

exercises.name: Forearm Rotate
exercises.hint: Start with thumb facing up. Turn your palm toward the outside so knuckles and wrist stay flat on the table. Hold, then repeat.

exercises.name: Elbow Bending
exercises.hint: Hold forearm folded up to your shoulder, then hold it stretched down fully open. That is one rep.

exercises.name: Elbow Stretch Bend
exercises.hint: Thumb facing up. Bend your elbow as far as you can — an assistant gently bends it further (no pain). Hold, then straighten briefly. That is one rep.

exercises.name: Elbow Stretch Straight
exercises.hint: Assistant supports the elbow with one hand and holds the hand with the other (no pain). Straighten the elbow as much as tolerated. Hold the stretch, then brief rest. Only on sessions 2, 4, and 6 today.

exercises.name: Fist & Open
exercises.hint: Make a fist and hold, then open with straight fingers and hold. That is one rep.

exercises.name: Thumb to Little Finger
exercises.hint: Touch your thumb to the base of your little finger and hold, then point the thumb straight up to the ceiling and hold. That is one rep.

exercises.name: Thumb Slide
exercises.hint: Palm on the table. Slide your thumb away from your hand.

exercises.name: Cup Hold
exercises.hint: Move your thumb away from your hand to form an "L" — like holding a cup.
